title: Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia The bitcoin price slipped to near $61,500 on Friday morning, its lowest level since July, as the tech selloff spread to Asia and IBIT posted a record outflow. This post Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
